core_views_blueprint.title: Ana Dashboard & Mağaza Karlılık Paneli
features: KPI Summary Bar (Total Revenue, Expenses, Net Profit, Margin, Amazon Balance)
Tüm Mağazaların Tarih Filtreli Karlılık Grafiği (Aggregate All-Store Date-Filtered Profitability Chart in USD)
Global Date Range Picker for Profitability Panel (Bu Ay, Geçen Ay, Son 3 Ay, Yıllık, Özel Tarih)
Multi-Store Comparative Profit Lines + Total Aggregate Net Profit Line (Recharts)
Company Treasury Cash Balance Card (Şirket Kasası: Distinct TL and USD Balances)
Quick Access to Recent Transactions & Store Disbursals

core_views_blueprint.title: Şirket Sermaye & Borç / Alacak Yönetimi (Yeni Menü)

sub_views.title: Sermaye Katkıları & Hisse Oranları
key_rules: Every capital record links to a Person (Partner / Ortak or External Investor / Dış Yatırımcı) and a specific Store.
Capital Investment ('Sermaye Yatırımı') contributes to equity share calculation.
Equity percentage is calculated per-store based on net funded USD equivalent: Ownership % = (Net Capital Contributed by Person in Store / Total Net Capital Invested in Store) * 100%.
Historical TL investments are converted to USD at historical contribution FX rate for fair comparability.
Displays visual share distribution table & interactive ownership progress bars.
ui_components: Investor Summary Cards showing total USD equity pool per store

sub_views.title: Şirketin Kişilerle Borç / Alacak Takibi
key_rules: Tracks only the company's debts and receivables with people, not separate personal accounts.
Debt ('Borç') is strictly repayable and does NOT affect store equity ownership shares.
Dual-Currency Option: User selects TL or USD per record; UI presents separate TL and USD cash balance cards.
Supports partial repayment logs, due dates, and status indicators (Ödendi, Kısmi Ödendi, Gecikmede, Bekliyor).
ui_components: New Debt/Receivable Dialog with Currency Selector (TL / USD) (data-testid='add-debt-button')
Debts & Receivables Ledger Table with status badges (data-testid='debts-receivables-table')

sub_views.title: Aylık Mağaza Kasa Kapanışı & Otomatik Muhasebe Kaydı
key_rules: Automatically transfers closed previous month's store net profit/loss into the main company vault / treasury.
Idempotent single accounting entry per store per month upon month close.
Store profit/loss changes the noncash USD book ledger; physical TL/USD cash remains separate.
Non-cash ledger history table with audit trail.
ui_components: Monthly Store P&L Ledger Closing Card & Manual Trigger (data-testid='run-monthly-close-button')

core_views_blueprint.title: Kar ve Zarar Raporu & Detaylı Sipariş Raporu
features: Waterfall P&L Summary Table (Gross Revenue -> Discounts -> Refunds -> Net Sales -> COGS -> Amazon Fees -> Advertising -> Net Profit)
Detailed Order Breakdown Tool (Tüm Siparişlerin Ayrıntılı Dökümü Table)

Excel Export Button (XLSX Download) supplying full order details, marketplace breakdown, product/shipping/extra costs, recoveries, FX and net profit columns; SKU remains removed (data-testid='download-excel-report-button')

interactive_states_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MANDATORY: Every input, button, tab, dropdown, table row, and modal must contain unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.
interactive_states_and_accessibility.dropdown_backgrounds: NEVER use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, select menus, or popovers. Always use solid bg-white with shadow-lg and border border-slate-200.
interactive_states_and_accessibility.hover_contrast: Ensure explicit hover states like hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white or hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:text-white.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use modern pill-shaped or sharp rounded buttons with responsive hover & active animations.
Do NOT center align main app container; maintain natural left-aligned data reading flow.
Add explicit data-testid to every interactive component.
Keep standard light theme crisp and high-contrast, utilizing tinting for table stripes and hover states.
Ensure all financial figures display appropriate currency symbols according to selected marketplace or default store currency.
